title: SUBPLEX: A Visual Analytics Approach to Understand Local Model Explanations at the Subpopulation Level

bias_targets.methodology: Interactive visual analysis of SHAP value distributions for gender-specific tokens (e.g., "woman") within clustered subpopulations of local model explanations to identify biased sentiment correlations.
Domain expert evaluation proposing the interactive exploration of age-related features and their local explanation weights to ensure models are not biased against specific age groups.
Domain expert evaluation suggesting the use of subpopulation visual analytics to inspect local explanation distributions for sensitive demographic populations regarding race.
